title: GoFlow
description: GoFlow is a concurrent job processing platform built with Go that enables users to submit long-running tasks through a REST API while background workers process them asynchronously. It features automatic retries, PostgreSQL persistence, graceful shutdown, and a live dashboard for monitoring jobs in real time.

title: PocketAuth
description: A zero-dependency JWT + OAuth2 authentication microservice in pure Go. Drop-in integration for any backend. Ships with an admin UI for managing users and scopes.

title: Cartographer
description: CLI + web tool for visualising PostgreSQL schema changes across migrations. Generates interactive ER diagrams and diffs as SVG — no GUI needed.
